imageNote: This lesson's central concept — three role-playing foreign keys to one physical DimDate table — is the exact same pattern Data Modeling & Data Warehousing's Lesson 27 illustrated with a real Microsoft-authored diagram (Flight fact table, Airport dimension referenced twice as Departure/Arrival). That diagram is reused here from the same origin URL rather than re-fetched, since it genuinely depicts the general role-playing-dimension mechanism this lesson's DimDate keys follow. The FactWorkOrder DDL itself is original, hand-written T-SQL — the honest choice for schema content, not a fabricated screenshot.
